title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows, unify release automation, and repo hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context and motivation: Our repo has accumulated multiple GitHub Actions workflows with overlapping responsibilities (node builds, lint/test, release automation). This causes duplicated logic, inconsistent cache keys, and flaky release runs. This PR consolidates CI workflows, upgrades core actions and Node versions, fixes caching edge cases, and cleans up repo-level scripts to improve developer velocity and reduce CI cost. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate node build/test/lint workflows into a small set of reusable workflows - [x] Upgrade actions/checkout, setup-node, and cache action versions; bump Node to 20 for build/test jobs - [x] Standardize cache keys and restore strategies across packages - [x] Migrate release automation to single composite workflow with explicit semantic-release step - [x] Remove deprecated scripts in package.json and add docs reference - [x] Add monitoring alerts to CI failure Slack channel - [ ] Follow-up: migrate self-hosted runner labels (ENG-2467). Changes: High-level changes include: 1) .github/workflows/ci.yml — unified workflow that runs lint/test/publish matrix, uses reusable job templates, and centralizes artifact upload; 2) .github/workflows/release.yml — new single-source release automation triggered on tags, uses semantic-release and a dedicated release runner label; 3) .github/workflows/cache-helpers.yml — small reusable workflow to compute cache keys; 4) scripts/ci/cache-key.js — canonical cache key generator (replaces ad-hoc inline keys) and documented usage; 5) package.json — removed legacy 'release:canary' script and updated build/test scripts for consistent NODE_OPTIONS; 6) action versions upgraded: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4; 7) GH app tokens: rotated install token reference (config secrets) and added CI_KEY rotation note. Commits summary: - feat(ci): add unified ci.yml with job templates (Aisha Patel) - chore(ci): add cache-helpers reusable workflow and cache key script (Aisha Patel) - chore(deps): bump actions and Node version to 20 (Aisha Patel) - refactor(pkg): remove legacy canary script and normalize test/build scripts (Aisha Patel) - docs(ci): update contributing.md CI section and add troubleshooting notes (Sofia Martinez). Files changed: - .github/workflows/ci.yml - .github/workflows/release.yml - .github/workflows/cache-helpers.yml - scripts/ci/cache-key.js - package.json - package-lock.json - docs/CONTRIBUTING.md - .github/labels.yml - .github/actions/semantic-release-config.yml. Testing and CI: The PR initially hit a flaky lint failure on Node 20 in the monorepo test matrix due to an eslint plugin mismatch. Debug steps: pinned eslint-plugin-import to v2.29.0 in root package.json and re-ran CI. CI results: Initial run: lint job failed on ubuntu-latest (eslint-plugin-import conflict). Rerun after pinning: all checks passed. Notable CI jobs: build:linux (matrix node:20), lint:monorepo, unit-tests:matrix, e2e:smoke (only on main branch for speed), release-dry-run. Rationale for choices: - Moving to Node 20 keeps parity with our Docker images and hosted runners; - Consolidating workflows reduces duplicated cache storage and speeds up PR feedback; - Using reusable workflows simplifies future changes and makes release automation auditable. Review conversation (high level): - Liam Chen: requested clearer separation between publish and canary flows; asked to add dry-run gating for release — addressed by adding release.dry_run input and internal check. - Sofia Martinez: asked to document how to rotate CI tokens and to add rollback steps for failed releases — added docs and healthcheck job. - Diego Alvarez: approved after CI green and verification on a staging tag. Merge details: squash and merge used; commit message: 'chore(ci): consolidate workflows and unify release automation'. Rollout notes: The new release workflow is enabled for tags matching v*.*.*; a staged rollout to non-critical repos was performed and monitored for 48h. Post-merge actions: update runner labels (ENG-2467), coordinate with infra to rotate self-hosted runner image, and follow-up task to migrate any remaining repo using legacy workflows. Release notes: - Consolidated CI workflows and reduced duplicated jobs - Upgraded GitHub Actions and Node to 20 - Standardized cache keys and added reusable cache helper workflow - Replaced legacy canary script and improved release automation. Breaking change: false
